title: (JTB) just the basics
description: this is a simple modpack with a lot of optional mods. meant for modification
body:
simple modpack with varable fetures to select, like DH or Voxy you pick or first person body, or not, Etc. it is only sligthly less than 50 mods (will all active) and tested with the basic mods.
also includeds mods like xearos world and mini map, sodium, partical rain, fusion, More culling, appleskin, dark loading screen, and more. this is a very lightweight pack so even people with a low-end pc or laptop can run it (decently) smooth especially on big multiplayer servers like; hypixel, or wincraft.
